name: Shio
source:
He can use Si to control multiple thoughts at the same time. His emotions and consciousness are constantly dispersed, so even Sora cannot read his mind. His foul language is innate, and he's so indifferent to others that he'll instantly forget their names.

[Translated from in-game profile]
